findings.summary: Format now runs while Logger.mu is held, so a custom formatter that logs through the same logger or calls a locking Logger method will deadlock, and slow formatters serialize all logging.
TestEntryFormatterRace starts goroutines without a WaitGroup or Wait, so the test can finish before they run and pass without exercising the race (same problem in TestEntryReportCallerRace).
Test comments are wrong or sloppy: they say "logging before SetReportCaller" in the formatter test, "Doing it twice" is copy-pasted, and "likelyhood" is misspelled.
The extra entry.Info goroutine added to TestEntryReportCallerRace doesn't test anything new.
